name: 5Surveys
selection: 5Surveys does not show survey duration reliably. Prefer surveys with the lowest star rating (1-2 stars) because they tend to be shorter and simpler. Skip surveys whose title implies a long diary or multi-day follow-up.
qualification: Qualification popups often render options as label, li, div, or span elements that have child elements; do not filter on children.length === 0. Match the exact visible text instead: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('label, li, div, span')).find(el => el.innerText && el.innerText.trim() === 'EXACT_OPTION_TEXT')?.click(); then click Next in the same script. Pick the most neutral answer such as 'None of the above', 'No', or 'I do not consume alcohol'.
navigation: 5Surveys embeds survey questions in a WebView. Fill text answers with the native input setter, dispatch input and change events, blur the field, and click the submit/next control in the same script. Use document.getElementById for numeric ids instead of querySelector('#0').
exit: If 5Surveys shows a 'leaving early' dialog, choose 'Lost interest' to confirm. Return to the survey list after any screen-out or quota message.
warnings: Quest Mindshare surveys use css-175oi2r classes and React-controlled inputs; use the native value setter before dispatching events.
The text-answer widgets use data-testid="question-input" and data-testid="submit-text".
